rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Release dated June 4, 2001: King Fahd in Jeddah 'today swore in the members of the recently reconstituted Consultative Council ... for the Council's third term, including Chairman Shaikh Muhammad Ibrahim bin Jubair', the Deputy Chairman and the Secretary-General.
